snippet.title: Fate’s Theater - Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist now on Steam!: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2804100/Fates_Theater/

Fate’s Theater is a mischievous micro-tales game where Fortune and Misfortune vie to twist mortal lives into short, rhyming couplets of bright serendipities… or gleefully gruesome doom!
